Unsigned cursor is scope/principal/revision checked, never an authorization credential.
CLI consumes every bounded page before selection; incomplete/foreign/changed catalogs cannot become an empty project or authorize duplicate setup.
Canonical local connection without a profile creates only a format-1 shortcut after exact setup/binding revalidation.
Remote association requires explicit logical workspace and retains remote_scope; resume and work use the same remote facade without copying host paths.
Existing binding GET may materialize authorization revision metadata; CLI discloses requested metadata revalidation and never claims effects_started=false for that path.
limitations: Catalog is inventory, not execution authority; every resume/action revalidates canonical binding and access.
CLI fixture integration does not qualify native provider execution, installed package or browser onboarding.
Dashboard workspace listing allowlist is the existing canonical handler; its UI integration is qualified separately.
